app_subtitle: Spawn Custom Tarnished Presets as Hostile World Enemies Dropping Their Carried Gear
mod_manager_banner_title: Using Mod Engine 2 or a Mod Manager? Read This First:
mod_manager_banner_body: Always point to your CURRENT ACTIVE regulation.bin (such as mod\regulation.bin or your Mod Manager's active profile). EnemyForge will inject the forged hostile enemies and loot drops directly into your existing modded file so all your current mods, movesets, and balance changes stay 100% intact!
mod_manager_banner_warning: Do NOT select a vanilla regulation.bin if you already have active gameplay mods—keep your current active file selected below.
dropzone_prompt: Drop custom Tarnished .json presets or character exports here
dropzone_subprompt: Files placed in input_presets are scanned automatically
opt_thematic_regional: Thematic Regional (Matched to Level & Gear Tier)
desc_thematic_regional: Places enemies in regions matching their strength (Limgrave -> Liurnia -> Caelid -> Altus -> Mountaintops).
desc_roaming_invasions: Positions enemies as hostile encounters near churches and landmarks.
desc_carried_loot_rule: Defeating an enemy guarantees receiving the exact weapons, shields, and armor they carry.
err_no_presets: No character presets found to forge.
